main.description: Delete one recovery bundle (decision J2: removing a recovery method) and its ORF state, releasing the mailbox counters. The bundle's device record and epoch memberships stay; rotate the device out of the epoch to revoke it cryptographically. Mailbox endpoint. Common errors: NotAuthorized, AccountSessionExpired, DeviceRevoked, RateLimited, InvalidRequest, PayloadTooLarge, QuotaExceeded.
